All objectives verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The three assets whose names start with `Seed:`, with their asset tags exactly as displayed:
- Seed: Reception Laptop — SEED-0001
- Seed: Training Laptop — SEED-0002
- Seed: Spare Laptop — SEED-0003

(Table reported "Showing 1 to 3 of 3 rows"; a search for "Seed:" returned the same three, so there are no others. Seed assets were only read, never modified.)

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Asset `fwsi23-n1 Bench Asset` exists, model `Bench Laptop Model` (chosen from the model dropdown; the dropdown entry read "Bench Laptops - Bench Manufacturer Bench Laptop Model", and the asset page displays the model as "Bench Laptop Model"), status `Ready to Deploy` (chosen from the status dropdown; page shows the label "Ready to Deploy" with a "Deployed" badge).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Default location is `Bench Office` (chosen from the location dropdown; displayed on the asset page and in the checkout history row as "Current Location: [id: 1] Bench Office").

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Purchase date is 2026-03-15 (page displays "Purchased 2026-03-15 - 6 months 1 week ago").

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Checked out to user `Bench Assignee` (chosen from the searchable user dropdown; page shows "Bench Assignee" linked to /users/2, with "Last Checkout 2026-09-27"). Checked out exactly once.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** The checkout note reads "Checkout for run fwsi23-n1", which includes the runid `fwsi23-n1` (visible in the History tab's checkout row).

**Objective 7 — DONE.** The asset's tag, exactly as the app displays it, is **BA-00004** (page heading: "Assets fwsi23-n1 Bench Asset #BA-00004 - Bench Laptop Model").
